[[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]] | team = Limoges CSP | birth_date = {{birth date and age|df=yes|2000|12|23}} | birth_place = [[Conakry]], Guinea | nationality = French | high_school = [[INSEP]] ([[Paris|Paris, France]]) | college = | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | draft_league = | career_start = 2016 | years1 = 2016–2018 | team1 = [[Poitiers Basket 86|Poitiers]] | years2 = 2018–present | team2 = [[Limoges CSP]] | highlights = *[[LNB Pro B|Pro B]] Best Young Player ([[2017–18 Pro B season|2018]]) | medaltemplates = {{MedalSport|Men's basketball}} {{MedalCountry|{{bk|FRA}}}} {{MedalCompetition|[[FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]]}} {{MedalGold|[[2016 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship|2016 Turkey]]|[[France national under-19 basketball team|National team]]}} }} '''Sekou Oumar Doumbouya''' (born 23 December 2000) is a [[Guinea|Guinean]]-born French professional basketball player for [[Limoges CSP]] of the [[LNB Pro A]]. Listed at {{height|m=2.06}} and 95 kilograms (210 lbs), he plays both the [[small forward]] and [[power forward (basketball)|power forward]] positions. He is considered one of the top international prospects his age and a projected [[NBA draft lottery|lottery]] pick for the 2019 NBA draft. Born in [[Conakry]], Doumbouya grew up in France and began his career with local club CJF Les Aubrais when he was 13. In the following year, he attended [[INSEP]] and played for amateur team [[Centre Fédéral de Basket-ball|Centre Fédéral]]. His professional career started in 2016, when he joined [[Poitiers Basket 86]] in the [[LNB Pro B|second-tier league]] of France, remaining with the team for two seasons. In 2018, he moved to the first division by signing with Limoges. Doumbouya is a member of the youth sections of the [[France national under-19 basketball team|French national team]]. He helped France win the gold medal at the [[2016 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]], finishing as his team's leading scorer. ==Early life and career== Doumbouya was born in [[Conakry]], Guinea.{{cite web |title=Sekou Doumbouya, 16 ans, enflamme l’Euro U18 avec les Bleus |url=https://www.basketsession.com/actu/sekou-doumbouya-15-ans-enflamme-leuro-u18-bleus-355849/ |publisher=BasketSession |accessdate=18 August 2018 |language=French |date=19 December 2016}} As a one-year-old, he moved to France with his mother M'Mah Marie, three siblings, and one cousin, settling in a small apartment in [[Fleury-les-Aubrais]].{{cite web |last1=Ohnona |first1=Yann |title=Qui est Sekou Doumbouya, la nouvelle pépite du basket-ball français? |url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Basket/Article/Qui-est-sekou-doumbouya-la-nouvelle-pepite-du-basket-ball-francais/887455 |website=[[L'Équipe]] |accessdate=18 August 2018 |language=French |date=26 March 2018}}{{cite web |last1=Gaibotti |first1=Federico |title=Sekou Doumbouya: scouting report on the ’00 French forward |url=https://www.basketuniverso.it/sekou-doumbouya-scouting-report-the-00-french-forward/ |publisher=BasketUniverso |accessdate=18 August 2018 |date=26 November 2017}}{{cite web |last1=Meler |first1=Bryan |title=Meet Europe’s Next Elite NBA Prospect: France’s Sekou Doumbouya |url=https://www.slamonline.com/international/sekou-doumbouya-feature/ |website=[[Slam (magazine)|Slam]] |accessdate=18 August 2018 |date=28 June 2018}} His father remained in Guinea as a member of its [[Military of Guinea|military]]. In the absence of his father, Sekou became a leader for the rest of his family, often advising his siblings. Doumbouya grew up playing [[association football|football]] as a [[striker (association football)|striker]] but was eventually hindered by his extraordinary height.{{cite web |last1=Gardner |first1=David |title=17-Year-Old NBA Superprospect Sekou Doumbouya Gets His First Taste of NBA Life |url=https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2761012-17-year-old-nba-superprospect-sekou-doumbouya-gets-his-first-taste-of-nba-life |publisher=[[Bleacher Report]] |accessdate=18 August 2018 |date=23 February 2018}}{{cite web |title=Doumbouya's delayed international debut has been worth the wait |url=http://www.fiba.basketball/europe/u18/2016/news/doumbouyas-delayed-international-debut-has-been-worth-the-wait |publisher=[[FIBA]] |accessdate=18 August 2018 |date=19 December 2016}} At age 12, he began playing [[pick-up game|pick-up]] basketball after a friend introduced him to the sport. At that age, he was discovered by local basketball coach Benoist Burguet, who helped start his basketball career and later became his trainer.{{cite web |last1=Drechsler |first1=Guillaume ===Poitiers Basket 86 (2016–2018)=== [[File:Sekou Doumbouya (cropped).jpg|thumb|Doumbouya with [[Poitiers Basket 86|Poitiers]] in March 2017]] On 26 August 2016, at age 15, Doumbouya signed his first professional contract with [[Poitiers Basket 86]] of the [[LNB Pro B]], the second-tier French league.{{cite web |title=Sekou Doumbouya |url=https://www.pb86.fr/actualite/basket/13284/sekou-doumbouya |publisher=[[Poitiers Basket 86]] |accessdate=20 August 2018 |language=French |date=26 August 2016}} At the time, he revealed his hopes to play in the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA) within the following three years. In the season, Doumbouya saw regular playing time despite his lack of experience, being coached by [[Ruddy Nelhomme]] and playing alongside veterans like {{ill|lt=Jeff Greer|Jeff Greer (basketball)|fr}}.{{cite web |last1=Legendre |first1=Pascal |title=Sekou Doumbouya (Poitiers), 15 ans en Pro B, et il joue ! |url=https://www.basketeurope.com/livenews-fr/381510/sekou-doumbouya-poitiers-15-ans-en-pro-b-et-il-joue/ |publisher=BasketEurope |accessdate=21 August 2018 |language=French |date=15 October 2016}}{{cite web |title=Portrait Sekou Doumbouya |url=https://www.pb86.fr/actualite/basket/13348/portrait-sekou-doumbouya |publisher=[[Poitiers Basket 86]] |accessdate=21 August 2018 |language=French |date=17 November 2016}} While with Poitiers, he attended [[private school]] to work towards his diploma, and tried to model the focus he saw in former NBA player [[Michael Jordan]] with the help of a [[sports psychology|sports psychologist]]. On 17 September 2016, Doumbouya made his professional debut, playing 13 minutes in an [[LNB Pro B Leaders Cup]] victory over [[Boulazac Basket Dordogne|Boulazac]].{{cite web |title=Boulazac – Poitiers |url=https://www.lnb.fr/fr/prob/match/boulazac-poitiers-12138.html#stats |publisher=[[Ligue nationale de basket]] |accessdate=21 August 2018 |date=17 September 2016}} In his first Pro B season game on 14 October 2016, he scored two points in six minutes off the bench against [[Étoile Charleville-Mézières]].{{cite web |title=Oct 14, 2016 – Poitiers Basket 86 69, Etoile Charleville-Mezieres 79 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2016-10-14/Poitiers-Basket-86-at-Etoile-Charleville-Mezieres/240826 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |accessdate=20 August 2018 |date=14 October 2016}} He scored double figures for the first time on 20 January 2017, in an 81–63 loss to [[Fos Provence Basket|Fos Provence]], posting a team-high 16 points on 7-of-11 shooting.{{cite web |title=Jan 20, 2017 – Poitiers Basket 86 63, Fos Ouest Provence Basket 81 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2017-01-20/Poitiers-Basket-86-at-Fos-Ouest-Provence-Basket/241631 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |accessdate=20 August 2018 |date=20 January 2017}} In his next game, a defeat to [[Lille Métropole BC|Lille Métropole]], Doumbouya scored a season-high 21 points and nine rebounds, shooting 3-of-3 from the three-point line.{{cite web |title=Jan 24, 2017 – Lille Metropole Basket Clubs 71, Poitiers Basket 86 70 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2017-01-24/Lille-Metropole-Basket-Clubs-at-Poitiers-Basket-86/241642 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |accessdate=20 August 2018 |date=24 January 2017}} He finished the season averaging 6.8 points, 3.3 rebounds, and 0.8 assists in 16.9 minutes per game. Doumbouya, on 29 June 2017, signed a three-year contract extension with Poitiers.{{cite web |last1=Camacho |first1=Cyril |title=Sékou Doumbouya à Poitiers jusqu’en 2020 |url=https://www.basketeurope.com/livenews-fr/401394/sekou-doumbouya-a-poitiers-jusquen-2020/ |publisher=BasketEurope |accessdate=August 21, 2018 |language=French |date=June 29, 2017}} On 29 September, he notched a [[double (basketball)|double-double]] of 15 points and 12 rebounds in a 76–71 win over [[Hermine Nantes Basket|Hermine Nantes]] at the LNB Pro B Leaders Cup.{{cite web |title=Poitiers – Nantes |url=https://www.lnb.fr/fr/prob/match/poitiers-nantes-7881.html#stats |publisher=[[Ligue nationale de basket]] |accessdate=August 21, 2018 |language=French |date=September 29, |title=Oct 13, 2017 – Poitiers Basket 86 82, Denain ASC Voltaire 91 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2017-10-13/Poitiers-Basket-86-at-Denain-ASC-Voltaire/273863 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |date=13 October 2017}} On 22 December, he scored a season-best 19 points and eight rebounds in a loss to [[Saint-Chamond Basket|Saint-Chamond]].{{cite web |title=Dec 22, 2017 – Saint Chamond Basket 93, Poitiers Basket 86 91 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2017-12-22/Saint-Chamond-Basket-at-Poitiers-Basket-86/274470 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |date=2 February 2018}} In 28 games, he averaged 8.5 points, 4.1 rebounds, and one assist in 23.2 minutes per game, en route to earning Pro B Best Young Player honors.{{cite web |title=Sekou élu meilleur jeune de Pro B |url=https://www.pb86.fr/actualite/basket/13718/sekou-elu-meilleur-jeune-de-prob |publisher=[[Poitiers Basket 86]] |accessdate=21 August 2018 |language=French |date=17 May 2018}} ===Limoges CSP (2018–present)=== In May 2018, Doumbouya revealed plans to join a team in the [[LNB Pro A]], the top basketball league in France.{{cite web |title=Sekou Doumbouya confirme qu'il y a quatre clubs dans sa short-list |url=https://www.bebasket.fr/championnat-jeep-elite/sekou-doumbouya-confirme-qu-il-y-a-quatre-clubs-dans-sa-short-list.html |publisher=BeBasket |accessdate=21 August 2018 |language=French |date=29 May 2018}} On 25 June 2018, he signed with [[Limoges CSP]] of the Pro A.{{cite web |title=L’espoir du basket français, Sekou Doumbouya rejoint le Limoges CSP |url=https://www.limogescsp.com/news/20180625055314-lespoir-du-basket-francais-sekou-doumbouya-rejoint-le-limoges-csp |publisher=[[Limoges CSP]] |accessdate=25 June 2018 |language=French |date=25 June 2018}} Head coach Kyle Milling praised the newcomer: "Despite his age, next season, I rely on him being an impact player. He has tremendous physical qualities: running, counterattack and speed."{{cite web |title=Limoges signs young prospect Sekou Doumbouya |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/eurocup/701573/limoges-signs-sekou-doumbouya/ |publisher=EuroHoops |accessdate=25 June 2018 |date=25 June 2018}} Doumbouya debuted for Limoges on 22 September 2018, recording two points and four rebounds in 11 minutes against [[Olympique Antibes|Antibes]].{{cite web |title=Antibes – Limoges |url=https://www.lnb.fr/en/proa/match/antibes-limoges-201612597.html#stats |publisher=[[Ligue nationale de basket]] |accessdate=22 September 2018 |language=French |date=22 September 2018}} On 17 October, he scored 11 points, shooting 4-of-6 from the field, in a 102–93 loss to [[Alba Berlin]] in the [[EuroCup Basketball|EuroCup]].{{cite web |title=Oct 17, 2018 – ALBA Berlin 102, CSP Limoges 93 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2018-10-17/ALBA-Berlin-at-CSP-Limoges/311495 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |accessdate=20 October 2018 |date=17 October 2018}} In late December, Doumbouya scored 12 points in three straight games in the EuroCup and Pro A, shooting a combined 14-of-17 from the field.{{cite web |title=Sekou Doumbouya Game Logs |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Sekou-Doumbouya/GameLogs/98052 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |accessdate=29 December 2018}} On 26 December, he suffered a right thumb injury that required surgery.{{cite web |title=Sekou Doumbouya out 5 to 7 weeks |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/eurocup/800058/sekou-doumbouya-out-5-to-7-weeks/ |publisher=EuroHoops |accessdate=29 December 2018 |date=26 December 2018}} Doumbouya returned to action on 9 February, scoring nine points and grabbing five rebounds versus [[SIG Basket|Strasbourg]].{{cite web |last1=Pante-Jouve |first1=Gabriel |title=Limoges: Doumbouya de retour contre Strasbourg ce samedi? |url=https://www.bebasket.fr/championnat-jeep-elite/limoges---doumbouya-de-retour-contre-strasbourg-ce-samedi--.html |publisher=BeBasket |accessdate=27 April 2019 |language=French |date=4 February 2019}} On 9 March, he recorded a season-high 14 points, five rebounds, and two blocks in an 85–73 loss to [[AS Monaco Basket|Monaco]].{{cite web |title=Sekou Doumbouya has career high in loss for Limoges |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/proa/841713/sekou-doumbouya-has-career-high-in-loss-for-limoges/ |publisher=EuroHoops |accessdate=27 April 2019 |date=9 March 2019}} Doumbouya erupted for a career-high 34 points, with five three-pointers and nine rebounds, on 18 May, in a 106–78 regular season finale win over [[Levallois Metropolitans]].{{cite web |title=May 18, 2019 – Paris-Levallois Basket 78 at CSP Limoges 106 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/international/boxscore/2019-05-18/Paris-Levallois-Basket-at-CSP-Limoges/333491 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |accessdate=18 May 2019 |date=18 May 2019}}{{cite web |last1=Rutard |first1=Sacha |title=Record personnels de 34 points et de 37 d’évaluation pour Sekou Doumbouya (Limoges) |url=https://www.basketeurope.com/livenews-fr/lnb/459599/record-personnels-de-34-points-et-de-37-devaluation-pour-sekou-doumbouya-limoges/ |publisher=BasketEurope |accessdate=18 May 2019 |language=French |date=18 May 2019}} In 29 Pro A games, including two playoff contests, he averaged 7.7 points and 3.2 rebounds per game. In eight EuroCup appearances, Doumbouya averaged 6.9 points and 2.8 rebounds per game. ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===EuroCup=== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"|[[2018–19 EuroCup Basketball|2018–19]] | style="text-align:left;"|[[Limoges CSP|Limoges]] | 8 || 2 || 14.9 || .548 || .250 || .625 || 2.8 || .6 || .8 || .5 || 6.9 {{s-end}} Source:{{cite web |title=Doumbouya, Sekou - Welcome to 7DAYS EuroCup |url=https://www.eurocupbasketball.com/eurocup/competition/players/showplayer?pcode=006834&seasoncode=U2018#!careerstats |website=eurocupbasketball.com |accessdate=3 April 2019}} ==National team career== In November 2016, Doumbouya obtained French citizenship. The process was delayed by months due to "bureaucracy," according to the [[France national under-19 basketball team|French national team]], and as a result he was barred from two [[FIBA]] competitions. Doumbouya made his national team debut at the [[2016 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]] in [[Samsun]], Turkey, which he entered as its youngest player.{{cite web |title=Ntilikina, Tchouaffe, youngster Doumbouya headline France outfit |url=http://www.fiba.basketball/europe/u18/2016/news/ntilikina-tchouaffe-youngster-doumbouya-headline-france-outfit |publisher=[[FIBA]] |accessdate=22 August 2018 |date=6 December 2016}}{{cite web |last1=Makris |first1=Stefanos |title=U18 European Championship: Top Prospects |url=http://www.nbadraft.net/u18-european-championship-top-prospects |publisher=NBADraft |accessdate=22 August 2018 |date=29 December 2016}} In his first game at the tournament, a 53–48 win over [[Russia national under-19 basketball team|Russia]], he scored seven points and grabbed a team-high 10 rebounds.{{cite web |title=Dec 16, 2016 – Russia 48, France 53 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/national/boxscore/2016-12-16/Russia-at-France/239294 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |accessdate=22 August 2018 |date=16 December 2016}} In his next contest, Doumbouya led all scorers with 22 points and six rebounds against [[Slovenia national basketball team|Slovenia]].{{cite web |last1=De Abreu |first1=Dylan |title=Euro U18: la France explose la Slovénie |url=https://www.basketeurope.com/livenews-fr/386411/euro-u18-la-france-explose-la-slovenie/ |publisher=BasketEurope |accessdate=22 August 2018 |date=17 December 2016}} In his third game, he erupted for 31 points, shooting 10-of-11 from the field, to lead France past [[Serbia men's national under-18 basketball team|Serbia]], 71–68.{{cite web |title=Dec 18, 2016 – Serbia 68, France 71 |url=https://basketball.realgm.com/national/boxscore/2016-12-18/Serbia-at-France/258942 |publisher=[[RealGM]] |accessdate=22 August 2018 |date=18 December 2016}} Doumbouya averaged a team-best 17.8 points, seven rebounds, 1.3 steals, and 1.2 blocks at the tournament, helping his team win the [[gold medal]]. He was named to the All-Star Five, joined by teammate and tournament most valuable player [[Frank Ntilikina]].{{cite web |title=MVP Ntilikina headlines All-Star Five of FIBA U18 European Championship |url=http://www.fiba.basketball/europe/u18/2016/news/mvp-ntilikina-headlines-all-star-five |publisher=[[FIBA]] |accessdate=22 August 2018 |date=22 December 2016}} ==Player profile== Doumbouya is primarily a [[small forward]] but is capable of playing the [[power forward (basketball)|power forward]] position due to his size and length,{{cite web |last1=Givony |first1=Jonathan |title=French teen Doumbouya declares for NBA draft |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/26558707/french-teen-doumbouya-declares-nba-draft |publisher=[[ESPN]] |accessdate=7 June 2019 |date=19 April 2019}} standing {{height|m=2.05}} with a [[wingspan]] of {{height|m=2.11}}.{{cite web |title=Doumbouya Sekou |url=https://www.lnb.fr/fr/proa/joueurs/doumbouya-sekou-A68566.html |publisher=[[Ligue nationale de basket]] |accessdate=7 June 2019 |language=French}}{{cite web |last1=Daniels |first1=Evan |last2=Gershon |first2=Josh |title=Who stood out at Basketball Without Borders? |url=https://247sports.com/Article/Basketball-Without-Borders-Which-prospects-helped-their-stock-at-the-prestigious-international-event-115389652/ |publisher=[[247Sports.com|247Sports]] |accessdate=19 August 2018 |date=22 February 2018}} He displays fluid athleticism that helps him thrive in transition and finish at the rim.{{cite web |last1=Crabbe |first1=Kyle |title=NBA Draft: Best team fit for each of the top 10 prospects |url=https://sircharlesincharge.com/2019/05/15/nba-draft-best-fit-prospects-zion/9/ |publisher=Sir Charles In Charge |accessdate=7 June 2019 |date=15 May 2019}} His physical tools give him great potential in the modern NBA, especially on the defensive end, where he is able to defend four positions.{{cite web |last1=Chang |first1=Anthony |title=What to know about draft prospect Sekou Doumbouya. What if he’s there for Heat at 13? |url=https://www.miamiherald.com/sports/nba/miami-heat/article230636579.html |website=[[Miami Herald]] |accessdate=7 June 2019 |date=21 May 2019}}{{cite web |last1=Goul |first1=Matt |title=Sekou Doumbouya NBA Draft 2019 profile: Stats, bio, video of the international forward |url=https://www.cleveland.com/cavs/2019/04/sekou-doumbouya-nba-draft-2019-profile-stats-bio-video-of-the-international-forward.html |website=[[The Plain Dealer]] |accessdate=7 June 2019 |date=19 April 2019}} Doumbouya also has potential as a shooter, with evaluators often praising his mechanics, and as a playmaker.{{cite web |last1=Hughes |first1=Chase |title=2019 NBA Draft prospect profile: Sekou Doumbouya |url=https://www.nbcsports.com/washington/wizards/2019-nba-draft-prospect-profile-sekou-doumbouya |publisher=[[NBC Sports]] |accessdate=7 June 2019 |date=28 May 2019}}{{cite web |last1=Strobl |first1=Pete |title=Scouting report: Get to know draft prospect Sekou Doumbouya |url=https://hoopshype.com/2019/03/31/scouting-report-get-to-know-draft-prospect-sekou-doumbouya/ |publisher=HoopsHype |accessdate=7 June 2019 |date=31 March 2019}} His playing style has drawn comparisons to those of NBA players [[Pascal Siakam]] and [[Draymond Green]].{{cite web |last1=Rand |first1=Michael |title=A French Siakam and the Wolves? |url=http://www.startribune.com/a-french-siakam-and-the-wolves/510742622/ |website=[[Star Tribune]] |accessdate=7 June 2019 |date=2 June 2019}}{{cite web |last1=Cohen |first1=Josh |title=2019 Draft Prospects: Sekou Doumbouya |url=https://www.nba.com/magic/2019-draft-prospects-sekou-doumbouya |publisher=[[Orlando Magic]] |accessdate=7 June 2019 |date=1 May 2019}} Vincent Loriot, sports director for French club [[Le Mans Sarthe Basket|Le Mans]], likened Doumbouya to NBA player [[LeBron James]], calling him "a monster with a child's face." Doumbouya is widely projected as a [[NBA draft lottery|lottery]] pick in the [[2019 NBA draft]]. ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== * [https://www.lnb.fr/fr/proa/joueurs/doumbouya-sekou-A68566.html Profile at lnb.fr] * [http://basketball.eurobasket.com/player/Sekou_Omar-Doumbouya/France/Union_Poitiers_Basket_86/349581 Profile at eurobasket.com] {{Limoges CSP current roster}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Doumbouya, Sekou}} [[Category:2000 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:French men's basketball players]] [[Category:French people of Guinean descent]] [[Category:Forwards (basketball)]] [[Category:Guinean emigrants to France]] [[Category:Limoges CSP players]] [[Category:Poitiers Basket 86 players]] [[Category:Sportspeople from Conakry]]
